label: SYNTHETIC
note: The evidence mapping of the fintech pack (ENV-04, ruling A208, relayed): how a stored source payload becomes rows of the reconciliation rule set's vocabulary. Closed lookups and one quantifier only, no expression language. A field the payload does not give, or gives as a value not listed here, is left UNSET: absence is never a negative fact (INV-19). The rows' meaning is the reconciliation's, so the Architect approves each. Three entities only, the ones the stand-in's ports provide (debit, switch, credit); a settlement or a reversal row needs a source that does not exist yet.
